subject.title: Subagent sessions persist after completion, main session becomes unresponsive

question: Should default run-mode subagents retain their session history, auto-archive/delete after completion, or only disappear from active UI/quota once terminal delivery is complete?
rationale: Current main has intentional keep-mode behavior and tests, so changing cleanup would alter user-visible history and Control UI/session-list semantics rather than only fixing a local bug.

options.title: Keep history, fix active semantics
options.body: Retain transcripts by default but remove terminal delivered run-mode subagents from active lists, active quotas, and parent-blocking paths immediately after completion.

options.title: Auto-archive completed runs
options.body: Change the default lifecycle so completed run-mode subagents archive or delete after a documented TTL, with upgrade notes and focused tests.

options.title: Status quo plus manual cleanup
options.body: Leave default retention as-is and expose clearer manual cleanup or Control UI bulk actions without changing runtime semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep history, fix active semantics
recommendation.body: Retain transcripts by default but remove terminal delivered run-mode subagents from active lists, active quotas, and parent-blocking paths immediately after completion.

likelyOwner.reason: Most visible history signal across subagent spawning, registry behavior, docs, and session utility paths.
